note: Calibration pass for the quality ladder: 20 MB of the corpus, 10.7x the parameters of the recorded 600 MB passes (width 16/ffn 32 -> width 64/ffn 192), a 32-byte physical window that can actually see a whole question frame, and 64 fact bindings instead of 2048. It exists to measure tokens/second and to find out whether this shape learns the binding at all before a long pass is spent on it.
purpose: Calibrate throughput and learnability before the full quality pass; see docs/PROMPT_RESPONSE_PRETRAINING.md section 8
